#### Bar

```{r plot_bar_groupsex}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 3
#| fig-align: center

targets::tar_read(plotdata_groupsex) |>  
  plot_bar()  +
  theme_mpxnyc_bar() +

  theme_mpxnyc_nomargin()

```
